name: Farinelli: A Cine-Concert
description: Experience cinema in a new light as the Orquestra Barroca Casa da Música performs a live score to the acclaimed film 'Farinelli'. This unique fusion of baroque music and cinematic storytelling is a must-see for culture lovers.
longDescription:
Farinelli: A Cine-Concert at Casa da Música presents a live musical accompaniment to the 1994 film *Farinelli*. The Orquestra Barroca Casa da Música performs the score, synchronised with the film's projection. This event combines cinematic presentation with live orchestral performance, offering a different way to engage with both the film and baroque music.

Attendees will experience the film *Farinelli* with the added dimension of a live orchestra in the grand setting of Casa da Música. The performance integrates the visual narrative with the auditory experience of a live ensemble. The event is designed for individuals interested in film, classical music, and interdisciplinary artistic presentations.

The event takes place on 2026-06-07. Casa da Música is accessible via the Casa da Música metro station, which is directly adjacent to the venue. Further details regarding ticket availability and pricing will be announced closer to the event date.
